g.text: 1.1 · User Prompt\nprompt\nThe requested change, exact names, and target scope.
1.2 · Exact Guide Identity\ninput\nOptional copied component or token identity removes discovery ambiguity.
1.3 · Classify\nrouter\nSelect exact-edit, reuse, compose, repair, extend, or create.
1.4 · Task Contract\nartifact\nRecords targets, creation permission, brand mode, budget, and validation scope.
2.1 · Resolve Context\nrouter\nQuery only the records and files needed by the Task Contract.
2.2 · Component Registry\nsource of truth\nDiscovery identity and current readiness; one selected record at a time.
2.3 · CSS Variables\nsource of truth\nValue truth for exact token and affected styling work.
2.4 · Astro Sources\nsource of truth\nExecutable component API, semantics, and runtime.
2.5 · Selected Rules\nsource of truth\nDetailed category guidance only for repair, extend, or create.
2.6 · Context Pack\nartifact\nRequired reads, skipped contexts, validators, alternatives, and missing inputs.
3.1 · Select Execution Profile\nrouter\nScale effort and permissions to the classified task.
3.2 · Exact Edit\nprocess\nEdit one named value or property.
3.3 · Named Reuse\nprocess\nImport and use an existing component.
3.4 · Compose\nprocess\nCombine named components into a page or local section.
3.6 · Extend\nprocess\nChange an existing API only after explicit intent.
3.7 · Create\nprocess\nCreate a genuinely missing reusable component after the Creation Gate.
4.1 · Scoped Validation\nvalidator\nRun the smallest validators selected for the affected change.
4.2 · Bounded Repair\nprocess\nRetry once for exact/reuse and at most twice for other profiles.
5.1 · Accepted\noutput\nReturn intent, reused assets, changed files, and validation.
5.2 · Blocked\noutput\nReturn missing input, alternatives, or exhausted repair.
C1.1 · Explicit Creation Intent\ndecision gate\nA page or section request keeps allowNewComponents false.
C1.2 · Gap Proof\nprocess\nCheck exact matches and reusable alternatives before creating.
B1.1 · Brand Activation\ndecision gate\nSkip for exact edit and named reuse; activate for open visual choices.
B1.2 · Approved Contract Rules\nsource of truth\nReturn only matching implementation-mapped rules.
B1.3 · Human Visual Approval\nhuman approval\nApprove new visual direction or propagation scope.
F1.1 · Explicit Figma Request\ndecision gate\nNormal Astro work bypasses this side path.
F1.2 · Selected Figma Operation\nprocess\nLoad one adapter and synchronize only the selected scope.
F1.3 · Figma Visual Repository\nexternal system\nEditable visual projection for exploration and review.
E1.1 · Representative Eval Cases\nprocess\nRun Polish and English prompts outside normal request latency.
E1.2 · Future Routing Improvement\nstate\nApply reviewed findings only to future requests.
